A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 7 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4500 identities would post 3758 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
